stations.title: 3D Rebar Cage Rigging & Precision Utility Positioning
stations.body: Rigid steel jigs support spatial rebar assembly outside the casting bay. Magnetic locators and mechanical brackets position MEP conduit sleeves, lifting points and grouting couplers before the cage is lifted into the mould.
stations.alt: Reference rebar cage production equipment; PPVC jig photo to follow
stations.caption: Equipment reference: rebar cage production. Project-specific 3D jigs are configured to module drawings.

stations.title: Monolithic Hydraulic 3D Box Moulding Station
stations.body: A monolithic five-face mould forms the walls and roof or slab in one pour, subject to structural design. A hydraulic power unit drives a shrinking internal core and guided exterior walls. Integrated vibration supports consolidation around dense reinforcement.
stations.alt: Reference concrete box mould with steel formwork and access platforms
stations.caption: Equipment reference: concrete box mould. PPVC core and exterior geometry are project-specific.

stations.title: Sectional Enclosure Steam Curing System
stations.body: Motorized insulated enclosures close over the casting station. PLC controls manage heating, constant-temperature curing and controlled cooling. Mix trials and strength tests establish the release schedule; an 8–10-hour cycle is a planning target, not a universal guarantee.
stations.alt: Reference enclosure for controlled curing in a precast production plant
stations.caption: Equipment reference: precast curing enclosure. Final layout depends on the selected casting process.

stations.title: Vertical Synchronized Stripping & Heavy-Duty Transfer
stations.body: Synchronized multi-point hydraulic lifting releases the module from its base while controlling differential movement. Rail carts or multidirectional AGVs connect stripping, inspection and finishing bays. Load distribution and lifting inserts are checked against the structural design.
parameters: Lifting points and interlocks engineered together
stations.alt: Reference rail transfer trolley for precast factory material handling
stations.caption: Equipment reference: rail transfer trolley. Payload and support points require module-specific engineering.

stations.title: Progressive Fit-Out & Prefabricated Bathroom Assembly
stations.body: Multi-level staging platforms give teams coordinated access inside and outside each module. The line can accommodate insulation, light-gauge framing, prefabricated bathroom unit (PBU) docking and MEP continuity and pressure testing.
